content: Biya gora edde bou sárar babute šikka
Bade Isa hentu uiṭṭe edde Ehudiya Elehat edde Zordanor dusora farot giye. Abar hibar hãse manuš okkole ai zoma oiye, ar hibaye hibar niyom mozin hitarare šikka diye.
He šomot hoekzon Foroši aišše edde hibare forikka gori saibolla fusar goijje, "Ekzon manuše hitar nizor bouwore sarifela iyan ki ain mozin?"
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Musaye tũwarare ki hokum diye?"

content: Hitara hodde, "Ekzon manuše hitar nizor bouwore sarhabos diyore dũrai dibar ejazot Musaye diye."
Toi hibaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwarar dil koṭin boli Musaye tũwaralla ei ain leikke,
Kintu sirištir šuruttu loti Allaye 'hitarare maya edde morod gori sirišti goijje.'
'Hetolla manuše hitar bab mare erizaibo edde hitar bou loi ek oibo, ar hitara duizon ek ga oibo,
ar hitara duizon ek ga oibo;' hetolla hitara ar dui nai, kintu ek ga.
Hetolla ziyan Allaye ekku fũwati zug goijje, manuše hiyanore aleda no gorok."

content: Toi góror butore hibar sahabi okkole ei ekkui befare Isare abar suwal goijje.
Hibaye hodde,

content.text: "Ze honokiye nizor bouwore sari diyore ar ekzonore biya gore hite hitar bouwor berudde zena gore.
Ar zodi ekzon mayafuwaye hibar nizor zamaire sari diyore ar ekzon loi biya gore, toile hibaye o zena gore.

content: Isa edde gura fuwain
Hitara gura fuwain okkolore o Isar hãse ainne, toi zene hibaye hitarare sui fare, kintu sahabi okkole hitarare gozgozaiye.
Isaye hen dekiyore hiba beši naraz oiye edde hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Gura fuwaindore ãr hãse aito do, ar hitarare banda no diyo, kiyollahoile Allar raijjo itarar ḍoilla mainšor.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, ze honokiye ugguwa gura fuwar ḍoilla oi Allar raijjo no gose, hite hono mote heṛe goli no faribo."

content: Tarfore Isaye he gura fuwaindore hate ãza mari loiye, edde hibar hat rakiyore hitarare duwa goijje.
Isa edde he tuwangor manušwa
Isaye abar za šuru goijje, hetunot ekzon manuš dũri hibar hãse aišše edde hibar sarme ãṛu felaiyore hodde, "Oh bala ustad, akeri zibon faibolla ãttu bala ham ki gora foribo?"
Kintu Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Ãre kiyolla bala hor? Allah ekzon sara ar honokiye bala no.
Tũi to hokumgun zano: 'Kun no goijjo, zena no goijjo, suri no goijjo, misa goba no diyo, honokiyore no ṭokaito, tũwar baf mare šorman goro.'"

content: Hite hodde: "Ustad! Gura halottu loti ãi in okkol falon gori aiyir."
Isattu hitare ador laigge edde hitar mikka saiyore hodde,

content.text: "Ehon o tũwattu ekkan ham baki ase, zo, tũwattu za kissu ase hin beggun besifelogoi, ar hin gorib okkolore baṛidogoi, henot tũi behostot dón faiba, tarfore aiyore ãr fisa lo."

content: Kintu ei zuwabor zoriya hitar nakmuk hala oigiyegoi edde ferešan oiyore giyegoi, kiyollahoile hitattu beši šombotti aššil.
Ar Isaye sairo mikka saiye edde sahabi okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Tuwangor okkololla Allar raijjot gola hondilla koṭin oibo!"

content: Sahabi okkole hibar hota funiyore ammuwak oiye. Isaye abar hodde,

content.text: "Fuwain okkol, hitaralla Allar raijjot gola iyan hondilla koṭin!
Tuwangor okkol Allar raijjot golattuwaro fũišor fai bai uṭ gola aro asan."

content: Henot hitara aro beši ammuwak oiye edde hitara ekzonore ekzone hodde, "Toile uddar hone oi faribo?"
Isaye hitarar hikka saiye edde hodde,

content.text: "Mainšolla iyan ošombob, kintu Allalla hár kissu šombob."

content: Toi Fitore endilla howa šuru goijje, "Ãralla ken oibo? So, ãra hár kissu felai aišši edde õnor fisa loiyi!"
Zuwabe Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, ze hono ekzone ãr namolla edde kušir hoborolla buli gór, bái boin, ma baf, futziyain ba zaga zobin eri difelaiye,
hitara ekšot gun beši faibo, ar akéri zibon o faibo. Ei zugot o gór, bái, boin, ma, fuwain edde zaga zobin faibo, kintu fũwati ottisar o bug gora foribo edde aiyedde zugot akéri zibon faibo.
Kintu funo! Hitarar foilar hataror bout kiye šešor hatarot oibo ar šešor hataror hitara foilar hataror oibo."

content: Isaye tisera bar hibar moron edde uwafes zindar babute hor

Hitara uwore Zeruzalem zadde fõtot, Isa hitarar age age ãṭṭil. Sahabi okkol ammuwak oiye edde zara hibar fise fise giye, hitara ḍoraiye. Abar hibaye he barozonore ek ḍaikka loigiye edde hiba nizor uwore zin goṭibo he babute howa šuru goijje.
Hibaye hodde,

content.text: "So, ãra Zeruzalem zair. Heṛe Adomor Futore ḍõr imam edde alem okkolor hatot tuli diya oibo. Hitara hibar bisar gori hibare moron šaza faibar laikka ṭoraibo, edde Oihudi okkolor hatot tuli dibo,
hitara hibare loi ṭaṭṭa goribo edde hibare sep maribo, souk maribo edde marifelaibo. Bade tin dinor din hiba zinda uṛi zaiboi."

content: Šašon no goijjo, kintu šeba goroya o
Bade Sebdeusor fuwain Yakub edde Yuhannaye Isar hãse aiyore hodde, "Ustad, ãra ziyan sai hiyan õne ãralla goro."
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara ki so? Ãi tũwaralla ki goritam?"

content: Hitara hodde, "Õne zẽtte kuduruti loi razagiri goriba hẽtte ãra ekzonore õnor den ḍakottu edde ar ekzonore ban ḍakottu boito do."
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara kiyor babute sor hin tũwara no zano. Ze motor fiyala ãi fito zair hin ki tũwara fi fariba? Otóba ze torikotor gusol ãre gora or tũwara ki he gusol loi fariba?"

content: Hitara zuwabe hodde, "Ãra faijjum" Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ze motor fiyala ãi fiyum tũwara fiba, ar ze torikotor gusol ãre diya oiye he gusol tũwarare o diya oibo,
kintu ãr ḍen ḍakottu otóba ban ḍakottu boito dibolla ãttu odihar nai. Ei zaga okkol in zaralla ṭik gori raka oiye, hitara hin faibo."

content: Baki došzone ei babute funiyore Yakub edde Yuhannar uwore gušša oiye.
Hetunot Isaye beggunore ekkui fũwati ḍakiyore hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara zano ze, zara Oihudi okkolor šašon goroya hitara hitarar uwore kemota sola, ar hitarar ḍõr manuš okkole hitarar uwore kemota sola,
Kintu tũwarar butore hendilla no on sa, bolke tũwarar butore honokiye zodi ḍõr oito sa, hite tũwarar šeba goroya ok.
Ar ze tũwarar butore foila oito sa, hitattu beggunor gulam owa foribo,
kiyollahoile Adomor Fut udda šeba faibolla nu aiye, bolke šeba goitto aišše edde bout mainšor azadir dam hisabe hibar foran dibolla aišše."

content: Anda Bartimeus

Bade hitara Zeriku šohorot giye. Isa edde hibar sahabi okkole ek ḍõr dolor fũwati šohorottu niyoli zargoide šomot ekzon anda manuš fõtor ḍake horat magedde boiṛa aššil. Hitar nam aššilde Bartimeus, Timeusor fuwa.
Zehon hite fuinne ze hiba Nasarator Isa, hite guzora šuru goijje, "Daudor bongšor Isa, ãre doya goro."
Boute hitare dõk diye edde nizam taito hoiye, kintu hite aro beši guzora šuru goijje, "Daudor bongšor Isa, ãre doya goro!"
Isaye tamiyore hodde,

content.text: "Hitare eṛe aito ho!"

content: Mainše he andaware ḍaikke edde hodde, "Himmot gor, uṭ! Hibaye tore ḍaker."
Hetunot hite hitar saddorgan ek ḍaikka felai rakiyore falmari uiṭṭe edde Isar hãse aišše.
Isaye fusar goijje,

content.text: "Ãi tolla ki goriyum, tui ki sos?"

content: He anda manušwaye hodde, "Malik, ãi suke deki farifan gori do."
Toi Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Dór, za! Tor biššaše tore aram goijje."

content: Henot hite hehon deki faijje edde fõtot hite Isar fisa loiye.
